changed: New contracts/value_formats.py: ValueFormat and the closed set decimal, integer, date, date-time, enum:<v1>|<v2>… and ref; parse_format (refuses anything else, and enum values with whitespace, Cc or Cf characters); value_passes (strict; ref refuses blank, Cc and Cf); FrozenFormats, an immutable mapping (read-only proxy inside; survives deepcopy and pickle as frozen; dumps as a dict); check_format_declarations(document, cap). CapabilityDescriptor.answer_value_formats (frozen by its validator). contracts/data_classes.py gains schema_nodes over a shared _frontier (path_exists unchanged). kernel/registry.py: one call beside dc.check_declarations, refusing at admission a format on a non-answer capability, a missing path, a path no data_classes entry covers on the path or an ancestor, a type that does not fit, or a mapping that is not frozen; registry.py is at 500 lines. The ERP manifest declares the per-contract formats of ADR 0023 §7; grounded.answer.v1 and the notes pack declare none. SDK_API_VERSION stays 1.2 (unreleased list). Tool schemas and both off model-request goldens unchanged. Commits c50c5a1, 38e67ef, 76af4fb.
